// swift-tools-version: 6.0
import PackageDescription

// Shared platform infrastructure for the Right Suite's native Apple apps. It owns licensing,
// diagnostics, artifact install, and QA seams — never app UI, product policy, or brand behavior.
// Foundation/CryptoKit only: no third-party dependency, so the registry archive stays portable.
let package = Package(
    name: "RightKitSwift",
    platforms: [.iOS(.v17), .macOS(.v14)],
    products: [
        .library(name: "RightKitLicense", targets: ["RightKitLicense"]),
        .library(name: "RightKitDiagnostics", targets: ["RightKitDiagnostics"]),
        .library(name: "RightKitArtifacts", targets: ["RightKitArtifacts"]),
        .library(name: "RightKitPurchases", targets: ["RightKitPurchases"]),
        .library(name: "RightKitCloudSync", targets: ["RightKitCloudSync"]),
        .library(name: "RightKitStore", targets: ["RightKitStore"]),
        .library(name: "RightKitImportQueue", targets: ["RightKitImportQueue"]),
        .library(name: "RightKitLiveActivity", targets: ["RightKitLiveActivity"]),
        .library(name: "RightKitWatchBridge", targets: ["RightKitWatchBridge"]),
        .library(name: "RightKitSpeech", targets: ["RightKitSpeech"]),
        .library(name: "RightKitIntents", targets: ["RightKitIntents"]),
        .library(name: "RightKitAppleCredentials", targets: ["RightKitAppleCredentials"]),
        .library(name: "RightKitOverlay", targets: ["RightKitOverlay"]),
        .library(name: "RightKitWatch", targets: ["RightKitWatch"]),
        .library(name: "RightKitUI", targets: ["RightKitUI"]),
    ],
    targets: [
        .target(name: "RightKitLicense"),
        .target(name: "RightKitDiagnostics"),
        .testTarget(name: "RightKitDiagnosticsTests", dependencies: ["RightKitDiagnostics"]),
        // zlib comes from the platform SDK; no third-party dependency enters the registry archive.
        .target(name: "RightKitArtifacts", linkerSettings: [.linkedLibrary("z")]),
        .testTarget(name: "RightKitArtifactsTests", dependencies: ["RightKitArtifacts"]),
        .testTarget(
            name: "RightKitLicenseTests",
            dependencies: ["RightKitLicense"],
            resources: [.process("Contracts")],
        ),
        // StoreKit 2 purchases, entitlement ledger, and the bridge into RightKitLicense access.
        .target(name: "RightKitPurchases", dependencies: ["RightKitLicense"]),
        .testTarget(
            name: "RightKitPurchasesTests",
            dependencies: ["RightKitPurchases", "RightKitLicense"],
            resources: [.copy("StoreKit/RightKitPurchasesTests.storekit")],
        ),
        // Generic CloudKit record sync; Foundation/CloudKit/Network only.
        .target(name: "RightKitCloudSync"),
        .testTarget(name: "RightKitCloudSyncTests", dependencies: ["RightKitCloudSync"]),
        // App Group primitives, share-extension intake queue, Live Activity lifecycle, WatchConnectivity
        // delivery ledger. Foundation-only (ActivityKit/WatchConnectivity guarded by canImport).
        .target(name: "RightKitStore"),
        .testTarget(name: "RightKitStoreTests", dependencies: ["RightKitStore"]),
        .target(name: "RightKitImportQueue", dependencies: ["RightKitStore"]),
        .testTarget(name: "RightKitImportQueueTests", dependencies: ["RightKitImportQueue"]),

        .target(name: "RightKitSpeech", resources: [.copy("Resources/whisper_mel_128.bin")]),
        .testTarget(name: "RightKitSpeechTests", dependencies: ["RightKitSpeech"]),
        .target(name: "RightKitIntents"),
        .testTarget(name: "RightKitIntentsTests", dependencies: ["RightKitIntents"]),
        .target(name: "RightKitAppleCredentials"),
        .testTarget(name: "RightKitAppleCredentialsTests", dependencies: ["RightKitAppleCredentials"]),
        .target(name: "RightKitOverlay"),
        .testTarget(name: "RightKitOverlayTests", dependencies: ["RightKitOverlay"]),

manifest.description: Blueprint: local evidence-backed repository map — documents, claims, code graph (Neurons/Synapses/Circuits), and orientation admission library.

package.description: Native Membrane federation coordinator and immutable provider registry.

package.name: cortex
package.description: Cortex durable-memory CLI for Membrane.

package.name: cortex-core
package.description: Cortex durable-memory core primitives.

package.name: membrane-client
package.description: Transport-injected client for canonical Membrane v1 operation envelopes

package.name: membrane-mcp
package.description: Native (Rust) public MCP hot path for Membrane. Serves the same JSON-RPC discovery surface as the legacy JS server so a clean user machine does not require Node.

package.name: membrane-provider-sdk
package.description: Membrane provider SDK. Exposes the typed Provider trait, the canonical Fixture shape, and the run_conformance harness so external adapters (Blueprint, Cortex, custom) implement Membrane operations against the same contract the runtime and the MCP tool surface use.

package.name: membrane-core
package.description: Membrane cross-provider budget and lane reconciliation. Owns the single cross-provider attention budget whose explicit lanes reconcile every receipt's selected and delivered tokens.

package.name: membrane-protocol
package.description: Membrane protocol contract: the single source of truth for the five typed shapes (ScopeGrant, ContextCandidateSet, ContextPacket, ContextReceipt, KnowledgeEmission), their canonical JSON Schemas, and the cross-language canonical byte/digest contract.

package.name: membrane-updater
package.description: Content-free dual-signature admission contract for Membrane updates

package.name: cortex-format
package.description: Cortex durable-memory format codecs.

package.name: membrane-testkit
package.description: Membrane testkit. Ships the canonical Blueprint and Cortex conformance fixture corpus and the golden_fixtures() accessor that returns the union of both sets. Used by the membrane-provider-sdk conformance test and by example providers in docs/examples/providers/.

package.name: cortex-store
package.description: Cortex SQLite store, installation identity, scopes, and durable telemetry.

package.name: membrane
package.description: Single membrane executable. Dispatches CLI, stdio MCP, loopback API, and supervisor-child modes from one signed binary.

package.name: membrane-runtime
package.description: Membrane federation, freshness, planning, and service runtime.

package.name: cortex_example
package.description: Reference Cortex adapter built on membrane-provider-sdk. Mimics the shape of the real Cortex adapter (handles membrane_knowledge_propose and membrane_checkpoint_save) and is wired to the membrane-testkit golden fixtures so it can be exercised by the SDK's run_conformance harness.

package.name: blueprint_example
package.description: Reference Blueprint adapter built on membrane-provider-sdk. Mimics the shape of the real Blueprint adapter (handles membrane_context and membrane_source_read) and is wired to the membrane-testkit golden fixtures so it can be exercised by the SDK's run_conformance harness.
